draft.text: You came in to talk about your heart health after having mitral valve repair surgery in 2020.
Your most recent ECG showed atrial fibrillation with a controlled heart rate and some T-wave changes in the front part of your heart.
You still have chest pressure 2-3 times a month and shallow breathing when you exert yourself, but these symptoms haven't changed since your last checkup.
We will discuss what to do next in the future.

unverified_summary.text: You came in to talk about how you're feeling since your mitral valve repair surgery in August 2020.
You say you feel better overall, but still have chest discomfort sometimes.
This feels like pressure and happens 2-3 times a month, lasting a few minutes.
You also notice shallow breathing when you exert yourself.
You have a history of mitral regurgitation and atrial fibrillation.
You are currently taking Coumadin, Lasix, and Atenolol.
Your symptoms have not changed since your last checkup, and you haven't had any new symptoms like dizziness, palpitations, or shortness of breath.
We will discuss your next steps during your next visit.
